subject: Security: pen-test handback & vulnerability management playbook
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Carter <amelia@medisecure.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: security & pen-test next steps

Hi Amelia — thanks again for the demo call earlier. Quick recap and a proposed set of next steps so procurement and security can plan: 

- SOC 2: you mentioned you need our most recent SOC 2 Type II scope and report. We have an in-progress Type II for infrastructure and controls; I can circulate the redacted report once legal signs an NDA.
- GDPR / HIPAA: you flagged potential PHI scope for a subset of traffic. We support HIPAA customers with BAAs; happy to route to Legal/Compliance for a draft BAA.
- Pen test & vulnerability process: you asked for our standard pen-test handback and vulnerability SLA/cadence. Attached is our base playbook and a sample SLA; below are two options we typically propose:
  * Option A (stricter): external pen-test annual + quarterly external scans + weekly internal scans; 30-day window for public disclosure for medium/low findings, accelerated windows for high/critical.
  * Option B (enterprise): annual third-party pen + monthly external scans + continuous infra monitoring; 72h/7d/30d/90d triage SLA by severity.

Could you confirm: (1) whether MediSecure needs the full unredacted SOC 2 or a redacted handback; (2) preferred disclosure cadence (30 vs 90 days for medium/low); and (3) whether procurement wants us to complete your vendor questionnaire (happy to take it).

Next steps I propose:
- You share the vendor questionnaire and preferred disclosure windows (Amelia/procurement)
- We confirm scope (HIPAA elements) and route BAA if required (Connor/Legal)
- Security team (Laura) will propose a concrete scan cadence and SLA matrix and attach the pen-test handback template

Attachments: Redwood_Pen_Handback_Guide.pdf (policy + sample report handback), redwood-scan-schedule.csv (sample cadence), Vuln_Response_SLA.md (SLA template)

Thanks — looking forward to the questionnaire.

Best,
Connor
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Connor — great summary. Attached is our standard vendor security questionnaire (MediSecure_Vendor_Questionnaire.xlsx). A few immediate clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: procurement will accept a redacted Type II report for now. If Redwood requires a signed NDA for the unredacted report we can escalate — procurement@medisecure.com is on this thread.
- Pen test: we'd like to receive a copy of the latest external pen-test report (redacted for customer-identifiable data). We expect a 30-day initial disclosure window for remediation on medium/low findings, but critical/high items need to be triaged immediately.
- HIPAA: we do have PHI in scope. Please confirm you support a BAA and provide standard encryption-at-rest/in-transit controls (TLS versions, KMS details).

I'll return the completed questionnaire by COB Fri if possible. Procurement will also want an SOW or MSA clause referencing pen-test schedules and SLA commitments.

Thanks,
Amelia Carter
Head of Security Operations | MediSecure

Hi Amelia — thanks for the quick reply and for sending the questionnaire. Looping in Marcus from SecConsults who runs third-party engagements if you want an independent pen test performed. A few concrete items from Security on Redwood's side: 

Scope & redaction
- We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report for procurement by next business day after the NDA is in place. The redacted report will remove customer identifiers and any PII.
- For pen-test handback, we provide a redacted external pen-test report suitable for customer review; full technical appendices are provided under NDA to your security team.

Recommended cadence
- Continuous internal scanning (weekly) for infra and dependencies.
- External authenticated scans: monthly for production-facing endpoints, quarterly for lower-risk surfaces.
- Third-party external pen-test: annual or on major product release. Marcus can propose an SOW if you want a formal assessment.

Vulnerability disclosure & SLA (suggested template)
- Critical: immediate acknowledgement + remediation/mitigation plan within 72 hours.
- High: acknowledgement within 24 hours; remediation plan within 7 calendar days.
- Medium: acknowledgement within 3 business days; target remediation within 30 calendar days.
- Low: acknowledgement within 5 business days; target remediation within 90 calendar days.

We typically ask for a 30-day public disclosure window for medium/low in commercial agreements; if you need a longer window (90 days) we can document that in the SOW.

Attachments: Vuln_Response_SLA.md (our standard SLA), Redwood_Pen_Handback_Guide.pdf (redaction policy + sample redacted report), redwood-scan-schedule.csv (example cadence)

Next steps:
1) Connor: I'll send the redacted SOC 2 and the SLA doc to procurement (and can drop the unredacted under NDA).
2) Amelia/Procurement: confirm whether 30 days for medium/low is acceptable; if not, we'll capture 90 days in SOW.
3) If MediSecure wants a third-party pen, Marcus will provide an SOW and timeline.

Happy to hop on a brief technical call if your security team wants to review the handback format.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
